ui.setup.screen_secrets: A password for the panel, a passphrase for the vault
ui.setup.welcome_line: Pour a coffee and sit back; this takes about a minute.
ui.setup.secrets_lead: Restoring a backup asks for the passphrase again; keep it somewhere safe.
ui.setup.ports_server_lead: Every port keeps its address and serves on it.
ui.setup.ports_differ: The HTTP and HTTPS ports must differ.
ui.setup.proxy_lead_server: Send this hub's own traffic out through an exit node you own.
ui.setup.proxy_lead_socks: Give this hub SOCKS ports that go out through an exit node you own.
ui.setup.proxy_lead_router: Send your devices' traffic out through an exit node you own.
ui.setup.socks_direct_enable: Also publish a SOCKS port that bypasses the proxy
ui.setup.proxy_local: Send this box's own traffic through it
ui.setup.interruption: The network may drop during setup; refresh the page when it does.
ui.setup.panel_will_be_at: The panel will be at {url}, and the run is written to {path}.
ui.setup.handover: The panel is starting. This page goes there in {seconds} s.
ui.setup.failed_lead: The terminal that started this run shows why.
ui.setup.lost: The ports are switching, so this page lost its link. The panel will be at {url}.
ui.setup.step_failed: a step failed; the terminal has the output
ui.setup.waiting_title: This box is waiting to be set up
ui.setup.waiting_lead: Open the link the terminal printed.
ui.setup.waiting_hint: If the link has scrolled away, stop the run with Ctrl-C and start it again.
ui.setup.mode_summary_server: Serves on the networks it is connected to.
ui.setup.mode_summary_side_gateway: Forwards for hosts that name it as their gateway.
ui.setup.mode_summary_router: Routes between uplinks and the networks it serves.
ui.setup.mode_summary_one_arm_router: Routes on one wire: untagged out, tagged VLAN in.
ui.setup.mode_caution_one_arm_router: The switch it plugs into has to pass VLAN tags.
ui.setup.router_note: Add more ports on the panel's Network page.
ui.setup.step_required_packages: Checking the packages the hub needs
ui.setup.https_description: Whether the HTTP port sends every browser to the HTTPS port.
ui.setup.install_title: Install the certificate on this device
ui.setup.install_lead: With it installed, the browser trusts the panel.
ui.setup.token_missing_lead: Open it from the Neutrino Hub app on this machine, or from the address the install printed.
ui.setup.token_missing_hint: Or run nhub open as an administrator on this machine.
